memories: Patch releases of the AI SDK that touch streaming are worth a PR.
A bump PR needs `git apply --check` and `pnpm typecheck` first.
Branches for dependency bumps are chore/<topic>; they are not covered by the fix/* rule.
Next.js image optimizer fixes do not affect us.
input.skill:
## Release watch
1. Read the release notes for Next.js, the AI SDK and libsql against our versions.
2. Open a PR only after `git apply --check` and `pnpm typecheck`.
3. Dependency branches are `chore/<topic>`.
